title: Brian Kelly Joins SiriusXM College Sports Radio for Weekly College Football Show
summary: The former Notre Dame and LSU head coach joins Danny Kanell and Roy Philpott every Wednesday throughout the season.
body_markdown:
Three-time Coach of the Year Brian Kelly is joining[SiriusXM College Sports Radio (Ch. 84)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/college-sports-radio) for the 2026 college football season.


[College Sports Radio Live game coverage, analysis & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BrianKelly)


The former Notre Dame and LSU head coach will join Danny Kanell and Roy Philpott every Wednesday at 7am ET, bringing more than three decades of head coaching experience to SiriusXM’s national college football coverage.


“I’m excited to bring what I’ve learned in my many years on the sidelines into the studio with the outstanding team at SiriusXM,” Kelly said. “I look forward to partnering with them every week to give fans an insider’s view of today’s game and the teams and players we’re watching every week.”


### **Listen to Brian Kelly on SiriusXM College Sports Radio**


**When:** Wednesdays at 7am ET
**Channel:** SiriusXM College Sports Radio (Ch. 84) in your car and on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BrianKelly)
**Hosts:** Brian Kelly, Danny Kanell, and Roy Philpott


Together, Kelly, Kanell, and Philpott will break down the biggest programs, players, games, and storylines from across college football, offering perspectives from both the sideline and the field.


Kelly brings 297 career victories to SiriusXM after head coaching stops at Grand Valley State, Central Michigan, Cincinnati, Notre Dame, and LSU.


During his career, Kelly led Grand Valley State to consecutive Division II national championships, took Notre Dame to the BCS National Championship Game and two College Football Playoff appearances, and won an SEC West title at LSU.


### **College Football on SiriusXM**


Kelly joins SiriusXM just as the 2026 college football season kicks off Saturday, August 29.


SiriusXM will carry more than 90 games during college football’s opening week, August 29–September 7, starting with 11 matchups Saturday. The opening-day schedule includes UNC vs. TCU at Aviva Stadium in Ireland, No. 14 USC vs. San Jose State, and Virginia vs. NC State.


Throughout the regular season and postseason, SiriusXM will carry dozens of live games each week featuring teams from the ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, SEC, and other conferences, plus Notre Dame, Army, Navy, HBCU football, and more.


[See the latest college football schedule on SiriusXM.](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/college-football)


### **SiriusXM College Sports Radio**


SiriusXM College Sports Radio features daily analysis and conversation from former players and coaches, Heisman Trophy winners, national champions, and college sports experts.


The daily lineup includes:


- **6–9am ET:** Danny Kanell and Roy Philpott
- **9am–12pm ET:** *Full Ride* with Rick Neuheisel and Chris Childers
- **12–3pm ET:** *College Sports Today* with Kris Budden, Nicole Auerbach, Dusty Dvoracek, E.J. Manuel, and Bobby Carpenter
- **3–6pm ET:** *Off Campus* with Matt Schick and Roddy Jones


College sports programming is available with SiriusXM’s Platinum, All Access, and Music & Entertainment plans. Beginning September 1, it will also be available with SiriusXM Sports Pass, the new sports-focused subscription plan priced at $5 per month.
